rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Everyone in $c, sortie!
rows.display_text: 「Everyone in $c, sortie!」

rows.speaker: Chuil
rows.en: Please do your best, everyone in $c!
rows.display_text: 「Please do your best, everyone in $c!」

rows.speaker: Anya
rows.en: We can't fight alongside you, but...
rows.display_text: 「We can't fight alongside you, but...」

rows.speaker: Brigitta
rows.en: I'll cheer you on with everything I've got!
rows.display_text:
「I'll cheer you on with everything I've
got!」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: If we lose after this, I couldn't call myself a man.
rows.display_text:
「If we lose after this, I couldn't call
myself a man.」

rows.speaker: Maria
rows.en: Let's do our best, Koji!
rows.display_text: 「Let's do our best, Koji!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Hold on a second! Maria's my partner today!
rows.display_text:
「Hold on a second! Maria's my partner
today!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Let's go, Katz! We'll shine in battle, and ride that momentum to win the table tennis tournament too!
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, Katz! We'll shine in battle,
then ride that momentum to win the table
tennis tourney too!」

rows.speaker: Katz
rows.en: Loran's got it rough... Having to deal with such a strong-willed young lady all this time...
rows.display_text:
（Loran's got it rough... Having to deal
with such a strong-willed young lady all
this time...）

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: Lunamaria, I'll need your support for this.
rows.display_text:
「Lunamaria, I'll need your support for
this.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Hold on, Touga. Lunamaria's my partner.
rows.display_text: 「Hold on, Touga. Lunamaria's my partner.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Even you, the pilot of God Gravion, don't get to butt in here.
rows.display_text:
「Even you, the pilot of God Gravion,
don't get to butt in here.」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Roger, Eiji! Let's do our best!
rows.display_text: 「Roger, Eiji! Let's do our best!」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Ah... he's a little frustrated.
rows.display_text: （Ah... he's a little frustrated.）

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: Aww, too bad. If Captain Bright and I had won as a pair, I could've been the commander on the Argama.
rows.display_text:
「Aww, too bad. Had Captain Bright and I
won as a pair, I could've commanded the
Argama.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Come on, even you wouldn't go that far...
rows.display_text:
「Come on, even you wouldn't go that
far...」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: This might feel different from usual, but focus, Shinn.
rows.display_text:
「This might feel different from usual,
but focus, Shinn.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: If you're that worried, why don't you back us up instead? You guys got knocked out in the first round, after all.
rows.display_text:
「If you're that worried, back us up
instead. You got knocked out in the first
round, after all.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Ngh...

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: I'm sorry, Athrun. Being paired with me is exactly why Shinn gets to talk big like that.
rows.display_text:
「I'm sorry, Athrun. Being paired with me
is exactly why Shinn gets to talk big like
that.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: N-no... don't worry about it.
rows.display_text: 「N-no... don't worry about it.」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: This'll be good experience too. Now then... how should we fight...?
rows.display_text:
「This'll be good experience too. Now
then... how should we fight...?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Gentlemen, it seems Zeravire's core is that new unit there.
rows.display_text:
「Gentlemen, it seems Zeravire's core is
that new unit there.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: This beautiful Gurabi Hot Spring must never fall into the hands of evil...!
rows.display_text:
「This beautiful Gurabi Hot Spring must
never fall into the hands of evil...!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Warriors of $c, dance beautifully to protect this paradise!
rows.display_text:
「Warriors of $c, dance beautifully to
protect this paradise!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Victory... Nothing is more beautiful.
rows.display_text: 「Victory... Nothing is more beautiful.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Whew... worked up a good sweat.
rows.display_text: 「Whew... worked up a good sweat.」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Well then, let's hop back in the hot spring...
rows.display_text:
「Well then, let's hop back in the hot
spring...」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: And after that, it's a table tennis showdown! You'd better start praying, Sandman!
rows.display_text:
「And after that, it's a table tennis
showdown! You'd better start praying,
Sandman!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Heh...

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: Let's do our best, Rey! Both the battle and the table tennis!!
rows.display_text:
「Let's do our best, Rey! Both the battle
and the table tennis!!」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: The two are not the same thing. Combat and recreation cannot be considered on equal footing.
rows.display_text:
「The two are not the same thing. Combat
and recreation cannot be considered on
equal footing.」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: Well, that's true, but...
rows.display_text: 「Well, that's true, but...」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: But since we're doing this, we must win at both. I'll need your cooperation, Miashei.
rows.display_text:
「But since we're doing this, we must win
at both. I'll need your cooperation,
Miashei.」

rows.speaker: Miashei
rows.en: Is he joking...!? Or is he serious...!? I can't even tell...!
rows.display_text:
（Is he joking...!? Or is he serious...!? I
can't even tell...!）

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Don't dawdle, Katz! Get our teamwork together properly!
rows.display_text:
「Don't dawdle, Katz! Get our teamwork
together properly!」

rows.speaker: Katz
rows.en: I'm not your servant...! I won't take orders barked at me like that!
rows.display_text:
「I'm not your servant...! I won't take
orders barked at me like that!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: What are you talking about!? We won the first round because of me, didn't we!?
rows.display_text:
「What are you talking about!? We won
the first round because of me, didn't
we!?」

rows.speaker: Katz
rows.en: This isn't the time to be talking about table tennis!
rows.display_text:
「This isn't the time to be talking about
table tennis!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: But if we sharpen our formation now, we can win next time too. Am I wrong?
rows.display_text:
「But if we sharpen our formation now,
we can win next time too. Am I wrong?」

rows.speaker: Katz
rows.en: N-no...

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Then move the way I tell you to. I know you can do it, Katz.
rows.display_text:
「Then move the way I tell you to. I
know you can do it, Katz.」

rows.speaker: Katz
rows.en: Y-yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Y-yeah...」

rows.speaker: Katz
rows.en: That smile of hers... I guess that's the best reward Loran gets too, huh...
rows.display_text:
（That smile of hers... I guess that's the
best reward Loran gets too, huh...）

rows.speaker: Emma
rows.en: Applying table tennis teamwork to combat -- that's not something an ordinary person would think of.
rows.display_text:
「Applying table tennis teamwork to
combat -- not something an ordinary
person would think of.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: But it makes sense. I suppose that's what you'd expect from Sandman.
rows.display_text:
「But it makes sense. I suppose that's
what you'd expect from Sandman.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Besides, every unit's movements are sharp. Must be the effect of the rest.
rows.display_text:
「Besides, every unit's movements are
sharp. Must be the effect of the rest.」

rows.speaker: Emma
rows.en: So it was all part of his calculations. He really is unfathomable.
rows.display_text:
「So it was all part of his calculations.
He really is unfathomable.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: All the more reason I'd like to win this tournament -- so I can challenge him myself.
rows.display_text:
「All the more reason I'd like to win this
tournament -- so I can challenge him
myself.」

rows.speaker: Beltorchika
rows.en: Aww... If I'd been paired with Amuro, I'd have made sure he won for sure...
rows.display_text:
「Aww... If I'd been paired with Amuro,
I'd have made sure he won for sure...」

rows.speaker: Astonaige
rows.en: ...Sorry about that. For being a partner not worth getting fired up over.
rows.display_text:
「...Sorry about that. For being a partner
not worth getting fired up over.」

rows.speaker: Reccoa
rows.en: Let's do our best, Shinn. I'm counting on you.
rows.display_text:
「Let's do our best, Shinn. I'm counting
on you.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Even if you say that, I've... never even played table tennis before...
rows.display_text:
「Even if you say that, I've... never even
played table tennis before...」

rows.speaker: Reccoa
rows.en: That's not what I meant. I mean the fighting.
rows.display_text:
「That's not what I meant. I mean the
fighting.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Y-yes...! I was... a little slack there!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes...! I was... a little slack there!」

rows.speaker: Reccoa
rows.en: What's wrong? You seem off -- did the hot spring get to your head, maybe...?
rows.display_text:
「What's wrong? You seem off -- did the
hot spring get to your head, maybe...?」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: I'm fine! I'll do this properly!
rows.display_text: 「I'm fine! I'll do this properly!」

rows.speaker: Reccoa
rows.en: Heh heh... I'm counting on you, Shinn.
rows.display_text: 「Heh heh... I'm counting on you, Shinn.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: We're not usually around each other much, so talking with Reccoa makes me kind of nervous...
rows.display_text:
（We're not usually around each other
much, so talking with Reccoa makes me
kind of nervous...）

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: But man, she really is mature... I wonder if that rumor about her and Lt. Quattro being a couple is true...
rows.display_text:
（But man, she really is mature... I
wonder if that rumor about her and Lt.
Quattro dating is true...）

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Count on it, Maria! Win big out there, and let's take the table tennis title too!
rows.display_text:
「Count on it, Maria! Win big out there,
and let's take the table tennis title too!」

rows.speaker: Maria
rows.en: Leave it to me! I'm not losing until I face off against Sayaka, no matter what!
rows.display_text:
「Leave it to me! I'm not losing until I
face off against Sayaka, no matter what!」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Heh... A clash of feminine pride between Maria and Sayaka, huh. This one's gonna be worth watching.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... A clash of feminine pride between
Maria and Sayaka. This one's gonna be
worth watching.」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: Lucky fella, ain't he... Koji's got all the girls after him.
rows.display_text:
「Lucky fella, ain't he... Koji's got all
the girls after him.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Same here. I'd love to have that kind of luxury problem myself.
rows.display_text:
「Same here. I'd love to have that kind
of luxury problem myself.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: You sure about that, Toshiya? Keep talking like that and you'll get dragged into trouble too.
rows.display_text:
（You sure about that, Toshiya? Keep
talking like that and you'll get dragged
into trouble too.）

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Heh -- so what if it's Zeravire! Let's just go smash 'em already, Sis Jun!
rows.display_text:
「Heh -- so what if it's Zeravire! Let's
just go smash 'em already, Sis Jun!」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: No, Kappei. If you charge in recklessly, you'll be playing right into their hands.
rows.display_text:
「No, Kappei. If you charge in recklessly,
you'll be playing right into their hands.」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: I've wanted to say this for a while, but your fighting relies way too much on momentum.
rows.display_text:
「I've wanted to say this for a while,
but your fighting relies way too much on
momentum.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Th-that's... um...
rows.display_text: 「Th-that's... um...」

rows.speaker: Uchuta
rows.en: That's it, Jun...! Tell him some more!
rows.display_text: （That's it, Jun...! Tell him some more!）

rows.speaker: Keiko
rows.en: Even Kappei's no match for Jun's intensity.
rows.display_text:
（Even Kappei's no match for Jun's
intensity.）

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: No making excuses. If you don't face your own flaws honestly, you'll never become a fine warrior.
rows.display_text:
「No excuses. If you don't face your own
flaws honestly, you'll never become a fine
warrior.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Y-yes! Understood!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes! Understood!」

rows.speaker: Keiko
rows.en: Heh heh... I guess Jun really would make a good match for Tetsuya.
rows.display_text:
（Heh heh... I guess Jun really would make
a good match for Tetsuya.）

rows.speaker: Sayaka
rows.en: Let's do this, Captain Lowen. We'll beat Zeravire and win at table tennis too, all right?
rows.display_text:
「Let's do this, Captain Lowen. We'll beat
Zeravire and win at table tennis too, all
right?」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Y-yes! I swear to General Edel that I'll fight with everything I have!
rows.display_text:
「Y-yes! I swear to General Edel that
I'll fight with everything I have!」

rows.speaker: Sayaka
rows.en: Please don't be so nervous. Being like that in the middle of combat is dangerous.
rows.display_text:
「Please don't be so nervous. Being like
that in the middle of combat is
dangerous.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: M-my apologies! But when I'm... alone with a woman, I just can't seem to keep my composure...
rows.display_text:
「M-my apologies! But alone with a woman,
I just can't seem to keep my composure...」

rows.speaker: Sayaka
rows.en: Geez... At this rate I'm starting to look like more of an enemy than Zeravire!
rows.display_text:
「Geez... At this rate I'm starting to
look like more of an enemy than Zeravire!」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: I'm making my move, Lunamaria. I need your support.
rows.display_text:
「I'm making my move, Lunamaria. I need
your support.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Hold it, Touga! Like I said before, I'm the one calling the shots today.
rows.display_text:
「Hold it, Touga! Like I said before, I'm
the one calling the shots today.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: But...

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: No buts about it. Lunamaria's my partner, and you lost to us.
rows.display_text:
「No buts about it. Lunamaria's my
partner, and you lost to us.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: ...I... lost... Because I lost... do I have to do whatever Eiji says...?
rows.display_text:
「...I... lost... Because I lost... do I have
to do whatever Eiji says...?」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: H-hold on, Touga...! You don't have to take it that seriously!
rows.display_text:
「H-hold on, Touga...! You don't have to
take it that seriously!」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: It's fine! He needs to learn the taste of defeat once in a while, that's all!
rows.display_text:
「It's fine! He needs to learn the taste
of defeat once in a while, that's all!」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: Ugh... getting carried away again...
rows.display_text: （Ugh... getting carried away again...）

rows.speaker: Mizuki
rows.en: Go ahead and do your best, Eiji. Because if you actually win, what's waiting for you there is hell...
rows.display_text:
（Go ahead and do your best, Eiji. If you
actually win, what's waiting for you is
hell...）

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Ha ha ha ha! I'm on fire today! Let's go, Lunamaria!!
rows.display_text:
「Ha ha ha ha! I'm on fire today! Let's
go, Lunamaria!!」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Roger! I'm not losing at table tennis or in battle!
rows.display_text:
「Roger! I'm not losing at table tennis or
in battle!」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: An invitation to a villa?
rows.display_text: 「An invitation to a villa?」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: A message from Sandman. He owns a villa resort along the route to Gibraltar Base.
rows.display_text:
「A message from Sandman. He owns a
villa resort along the route to Gibraltar
Base.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: He would like to invite everyone from $c there.
rows.display_text:
「He would like to invite everyone from
$c there.」

rows.speaker: Hanae
rows.en: Quite the extravagance. Just what you'd expect from our mysterious billionaire.
rows.display_text:
「Quite the extravagance. Just what you'd
expect from our mysterious billionaire.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: Actually, it doubles as a retreat for the maids as well -- the Earthgertz members are already on their way to the villa.
rows.display_text:
「Also a maids' retreat -- Earthgertz
members are already headed there.」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: There's still time before the meeting with Chairman Durandal. A bit of a breather now and then wouldn't hurt.
rows.display_text:
「There's still time before the Chairman
Durandal meeting. A bit of a breather now
and then wouldn't hurt.」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: Captain Gladys and Captain Bright both say it's no problem.
rows.display_text:
「Captain Gladys and Captain Bright both
say it's no problem.」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: Very well then, Raven. We'll take you up on your kind offer this time.
rows.display_text:
「Very well then, Raven. We'll take you
up on your kind offer this time.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: Understood. I'm sure Sandman will be pleased.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. I'm sure Sandman will be
pleased.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: I have duties to attend to in Japan, so Tessera and the others will handle your guidance on site.
rows.display_text:
「I have duties in Japan, so Tessera and
the others will handle your guidance on
site.」

rows.speaker: Umee
rows.en: Oh my... such a fine trip, and you're stuck minding the house, Raven dear?
rows.display_text:
「Oh my... such a fine trip, and you're
stuck minding the house, Raven dear?」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: ...Yeah...

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: He really wanted to go, didn't he...
rows.display_text: （He really wanted to go, didn't he...）

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Hey...

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: What's up, Eiji?
rows.display_text: 「What's up, Eiji?」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: This is the villa resort Sandman specified, right?
rows.display_text:
「This is the villa resort Sandman
specified, right?」

rows.speaker: Eina
rows.en: Yes, there's no mistake.
rows.display_text: 「Yes, there's no mistake.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: This is... the western part of the Gallia Continent, right?
rows.display_text:
「This is... the western part of the
Gallia Continent, right?」

rows.speaker: Sayaka
rows.en: In terms of our world, that'd be northern Africa... around the Sahara Desert.
rows.display_text:
「In terms of our world, that'd be
northern Africa... around the Sahara
Desert.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: How is this Africa!? However you look at it, this is a Japanese hot spring town!
rows.display_text:
「How is this Africa!? However you look
at it, this is a Japanese hot spring town!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Was this Japanese hot spring swept over here by Break the World...?
rows.display_text:
「Was this Japanese hot spring swept
over here by Break the World...?」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: No... This whole landscape -- mountains, rivers, all of it -- looks to be entirely man-made.
rows.display_text:
「No... This whole landscape -- mountains,
rivers, all of it -- looks to be entirely
man-made.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Then...!?

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: You're saying Sandman built this whole hot spring himself...!?
rows.display_text:
「You're saying Sandman built this whole
hot spring himself...!?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: It seems you've taken a liking to it.
rows.display_text: 「It seems you've taken a liking to it.」

rows.speaker: Leele
rows.en: Uncl--
rows.display_text: 「Uncl--」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Welcome to Gurabi Hot Spring.
rows.display_text: 「Welcome to Gurabi Hot Spring.」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: Gravion Hot Spring...!?
rows.display_text: 「Gravion Hot Spring...!?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: No, it's Gurabi Hot Spring.
rows.display_text: 「No, it's Gurabi Hot Spring.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: He actually went out of his way to correct that...! Is he that particular about the name...!?
rows.display_text:
（He actually went out of his way to
correct that...! Is he that particular
about the name...!?）

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Indeed... This is paradise, brought down to earth.
rows.display_text:
「Indeed... This is paradise, brought down
to earth.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: ...Still, I'd heard he was a billionaire, but Sandman never ceases to surprise.
rows.display_text:
「...Still, I'd heard he was a billionaire,
but Sandman never ceases to surprise.」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: Who would've thought he'd turn an entire resort into a Japanese-style town.
rows.display_text:
「Who would've thought he'd turn an
entire resort into a Japanese-style town.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Guess money really can do anything.
rows.display_text: 「Guess money really can do anything.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Still, who spends money like this...?
rows.display_text: 「Still, who spends money like this...?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Don't let it get to you, Shinn. This must be what Sandman calls his aesthetic.
rows.display_text:
「Don't let it get to you, Shinn. This
must be what Sandman calls his aesthetic.」

rows.speaker: Beltorchika
rows.en: The mysterious billionaire... His true face is almost too eccentric to believe.
rows.display_text:
「The mysterious billionaire... His true
face is almost too eccentric to believe.」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Well... putting his taste aside, since we're here, let's enjoy a warrior's well-earned rest.
rows.display_text:
「Well... putting his taste aside, let's
enjoy a warrior's well-earned rest while
we're here.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Yeah. Let's allow ourselves a bit of a change of pace.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah. Let's allow ourselves a bit of a
change of pace.」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: Stuffed myself full at dinner, and Captain Gengoro and the others are good'n drunk after a few rounds.
rows.display_text:
「Stuffed myself at dinner, and Captain
Gengoro and the others are drunk after a
few rounds too.」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: Polished my skin to perfection in the hot spring too -- this is the best!
rows.display_text:
「Polished my skin to perfection in the
hot spring too -- this is the best!」

rows.speaker: Guin
rows.en: I'd heard tales of these so-called Yapan hot springs, but I never imagined they'd be this soothing.
rows.display_text:
「I'd heard tales of these Yapan hot
springs, but never imagined they'd be this
soothing.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: This is nice, isn't it -- everyone soaking together in one big bath.
rows.display_text:
「This is nice, isn't it -- everyone
soaking together in one big bath.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: I wonder what's next...? Gathering everyone at a place like this.
rows.display_text:
「I wonder what's next...? Gathering
everyone at a place like this.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Speaking of hot springs, karaoke's a given, right? I'll show you my pride and joy -- my singing voice.
rows.display_text:
「Hot springs mean karaoke, right? I'll
show you my pride and joy -- my singing
voice.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Eiji singing, huh. With that voice, I doubt there's much to look forward to.
rows.display_text:
「Eiji singing, huh. With that voice, I
doubt there's much to look forward to.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: You said it, you jerk! Don't go crying in shock when you hear it.
rows.display_text:
「You said it, you jerk! Don't go crying
in shock when you hear it.」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: Hey, Touga. Let's do a duet together!
rows.display_text: 「Hey, Touga. Let's do a duet together!」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: By the way, what's karaoke?
rows.display_text: 「By the way, what's karaoke?」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Just how out of touch with the world are you...
rows.display_text:
「Just how out of touch with the world
are you...」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: A karaoke contest, then. I'm getting fired up too.
rows.display_text:
「A karaoke contest, then. I'm getting
fired up too.」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: My sister really does love a competition...
rows.display_text:
「My sister really does love a
competition...」

rows.speaker: Tessera
rows.en: If I may, please wait...!
rows.display_text: 「If I may, please wait...!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Hey, it's the maid ladies!
rows.display_text: 「Hey, it's the maid ladies!」

rows.speaker: Marinia
rows.en: Even at rest, a warrior must never forget how to fight. ...Those are Lord Sandman's own words.
rows.display_text:
「Even at rest, a warrior must never
forget how to fight. ...Lord Sandman's own
words.」

rows.speaker: Chuil
rows.en: Payo! And with that, it's time for the fun duel event to begin!
rows.display_text:
「Payo! And with that, it's time for the
fun duel event to begin!」

rows.speaker: Uchuta
rows.en: A 'fun duel'...?
rows.display_text: 「A 'fun duel'...?」

rows.speaker: Keiko
rows.en: That sounds like a total contradiction...
rows.display_text: 「That sounds like a total contradiction...」

rows.speaker: Toria
rows.en: Now then, everyone! Does anyone know what this is in front of you!?
rows.display_text:
「Now then, everyone! Does anyone know
what this is in front of you!?」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: You mean this green table?
rows.display_text: 「You mean this green table?」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Which means...
rows.display_text: 「Which means...」

rows.speaker: Tessera
rows.en: Ladies and gentlemen! We now begin the table tennis tournament -- the Sandman Cup!
rows.display_text:
「Ladies and gentlemen! We now begin the
table tennis tournament -- the Sandman
Cup!」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: ...And that's how the table tennis tournament started?
rows.display_text:
「...And that's how the table tennis
tournament started?」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: That's right. It's a tournament of male-female pairs decided by lottery.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. It's a tournament of
male-female pairs decided by lottery.」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: The winning pair faces off against the host, Team Sandman, and if they win that match, a luxurious prize awaits.
rows.display_text:
「The winning pair faces the host, Team
Sandman, and if they win, a luxurious
prize awaits.」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: A prize prepared by Sandman, huh... That sounds like something to look forward to.
rows.display_text:
「A prize prepared by Sandman, huh...
That sounds like something to look
forward to.」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: The first round's already finished, and the eight teams advancing to the quarterfinals have been decided.
rows.display_text:
「The first round's over, and the eight
teams advancing to the quarterfinals are
decided.」

rows.speaker: Keiko
rows.en: Though Uchuta and I already lost as a pair.
rows.display_text:
「Though Uchuta and I already lost as a
pair.」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: Ichitaro... how'd you do?
rows.display_text: 「Ichitaro... how'd you do?」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: ...I lost in straight sets.
rows.display_text: 「...I lost in straight sets.」

rows.speaker: Mizuki
rows.en: You should hear this, Captain. Even though he got paired with me, Ichitaro made nothing but silly mistakes the whole time.
rows.display_text:
「Listen, Captain -- despite being paired
with me, Ichitaro made only silly mistakes.」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: B-but, that's because! You'd just come from the bath, Mizuki, and I didn't know where to look...
rows.display_text:
「B-but, that's because! You'd just come
from the bath, Mizuki -- I didn't know
where to look...」

rows.speaker: Mizuki
rows.en: Where to look how?
rows.display_text: 「Where to look how?」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: There's no way I can say that out loud!
rows.display_text:
「There's no way I can say that out
loud!」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: That's pathetic, Ichitaro! How's a King Beal gunner supposed to -- no, how's a fisherman's son supposed to handle himself with that kind of talk!!
rows.display_text:
「Pathetic, Ichitaro! No way a King Beal
gunner -- or a fisherman's son -- acts
like that!!」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: If you're a man, push forward! Push through! Never forget to keep pushing!
rows.display_text:
「If you're a man, push forward! Push
through! Never forget to keep pushing!」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: Y-yes, sir!!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes, sir!!」

rows.speaker: Mizuki
rows.en: ...Captain, I think you've had quite a bit to drink...
rows.display_text:
「...Captain, I think you've had quite a
bit to drink...」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Too bad, $n. We made it pretty far, but...
rows.display_text:
「Too bad, $n. We made it pretty far,
but...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Sorry~, Kamille. If only my serve had landed right there~, we might've actually won~.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry~, Kamille. If only my serve had
landed right there~, we might've actually
won~.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: No... I think we fought really well. That point just came down to Amuro outreading us.
rows.display_text:
「No... I think we fought really well.
That point just came down to Amuro
outreading us.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: 'I can see it...!' That's just how he is, huh~...
rows.display_text:
「'I can see it...!' That's just how he is,
huh~...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Haah~... I guess ace pilots really are strong even at games like this~.
rows.display_text:
「Haah~... I guess ace pilots really are
strong even at games like this~.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: $n... your face is red.
rows.display_text: 「$n... your face is red.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I'm already twenty, you know~, so I tried a little beer, ahaha~...
rows.display_text:
「I'm already twenty, you know~, so I
tried a little beer, ahaha~...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I couldn't really tell what it tasted like, but cold beer sure is fun, huh, Chief...
rows.display_text:
（I couldn't really tell what it tasted
like, but cold beer sure is fun, huh,
Chief...）

rows.speaker: Cecil
rows.en: I'm sorry, Lord Tetsuya... Even though I was your partner, I couldn't help you at all.
rows.display_text:
「I'm sorry, Lord Tetsuya... Even though I
was your partner, I couldn't help you at
all.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: Don't worry about it, Cecil. We just have to admit our opponent was better, plain and simple.
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry, Cecil. We just have to
admit our opponent was better, plain and
simple.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: Still, moving your body matters. Make sure you keep up your training.
rows.display_text:
「Still, moving your body matters. Make
sure you keep up your training.」

rows.speaker: Cecil
rows.en: Yes. I'll work hard at cleaning and laundry.
rows.display_text:
「Yes. I'll work hard at cleaning and
laundry.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: You're being awfully gentle, Tetsuya! Where'd your usual demon coach act go!?
rows.display_text:
「You're being awfully gentle, Tetsuya!
Where'd your usual demon coach act go!?」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: Heh... You're one to talk, Koji -- you fought hard enough for Leele's share too.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... You're one to talk, Koji -- you
fought hard enough for Leele's share too.」

rows.speaker: Leele
rows.en: Thank you very much, Koji. I... had a really wonderful time.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you very much, Koji. I... had a
really wonderful time.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Heh heh... too bad we lost, but I worked up a good sweat!
rows.display_text:
「Heh heh... too bad we lost, but I
worked up a good sweat!」

rows.speaker: Tessera
rows.en: They've got a nice atmosphere going over there.
rows.display_text:
「They've got a nice atmosphere going
over there.」

rows.speaker: Chuil
rows.en: Yeah! Cecil and Lady Leele both have such nice smiles! And Lord Koji and Lord Tetsuya are wonderful too!
rows.display_text:
「Yeah! Cecil and Lady Leele both have
such nice smiles! Lord Koji and Lord
Tetsuya are wonderful too!」

rows.speaker: Marinia
rows.en: By comparison, though...
rows.display_text: 「By comparison, though...」

rows.speaker: Boss
rows.en: What!? What's your problem, you maid girls!?
rows.display_text:
「What!? What's your problem, you maid
girls!?」

rows.speaker: Mucha
rows.en: You that unhappy that we ended up as your partners!?
rows.display_text:
「You that unhappy that we ended up as
your partners!?」

rows.speaker: Nuke
rows.en: Th-that's so mean...! This is discrimination!!
rows.display_text:
「Th-that's so mean...! This is
discrimination!!」

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: I must say, I'm surprised... To think Lt. Quattro would join in on something like this.
rows.display_text:
「I must say, I'm surprised... To think
Lt. Quattro would join in on something
like this.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Even I have a life outside the battlefield. ...Though it seems I can't handle a paddle quite the way I handle a mobile suit.
rows.display_text:
「I've a life outside battle too. ...Not
quite like piloting a mobile suit.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Thank you for being my lady's partner, Lieutenant.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you for being my lady's partner,
Lieutenant.」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: Oh, Loran! Instead of worrying about Kihel, you should focus on our pair, you know!
rows.display_text:
「Oh, Loran! Instead of worrying about
Kihel, you should focus on our pair, you
know!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: S-sorry, Minako! I've... never played something like this before...
rows.display_text:
「S-sorry, Minako! I've... never played
something like this before...」

rows.speaker: Kihel
rows.en: Heh heh... Loran Cehack might just have been born under a star that dooms him to be pushed around by young ladies.
rows.display_text:
（Heh heh... Loran Cehack might've been
born under a star dooming him to be
pushed around by young ladies.）

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: Too bad, Meyrin. Losing to Lunamaria like that.
rows.display_text:
「Too bad, Meyrin. Losing to Lunamaria
like that.」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Can't be helped. My sister's good at sports too.
rows.display_text:
「Can't be helped. My sister's good at
sports too.」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: But aren't you frustrated, Touga? You lost to Eiji, after all.
rows.display_text:
「But aren't you frustrated, Touga? You
lost to Eiji, after all.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: Frustrated... why would I be?
rows.display_text: 「Frustrated... why would I be?」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Eiji... after finally beating Touga, this must be pretty unsatisfying for him, huh.
rows.display_text:
（Eiji... after finally beating Touga, this
must be pretty unsatisfying for him, huh.）

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Aah... Touga's got such a nice voice, but he really is a little strange...
rows.display_text:
（Aah... Touga's got such a nice voice,
but he really is a little strange...）

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: You look pretty worn out too, Eina. Are you all right?
rows.display_text:
「You look pretty worn out too, Eina. Are
you all right?」

rows.speaker: Eina
rows.en: My body's fine, but my head feels like it's about to short-circuit.
rows.display_text:
「My body's fine, but my head feels like
it's about to short-circuit.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Too bad, Eina. If you'd been able to fully put my sports theory into practice, victory would've been guaranteed.
rows.display_text:
「Too bad, Eina. Had you fully applied my
sports theory, victory would've been
guaranteed.」

rows.speaker: Eina
rows.en: What you say is way too complicated for me, Julie!
rows.display_text:
「What you say is way too complicated
for me, Julie!」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: ...Lucky fellas... Touga and Julie both got such flashy partners...
rows.display_text:
「...Lucky fellas... Touga and Julie both
got such flashy partners...」

rows.speaker: Hanae
rows.en: What's that, Kiraken!? You got a problem with me as your partner!?
rows.display_text:
「What's that, Kiraken!? You got a
problem with me as your partner!?」

rows.speaker: Hanae
rows.en: If it was just about power, we'd have been number one out of every team.
rows.display_text:
「If it was just about power, we'd have
been number one out of every team.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Which is exactly why every single shot went sailing out of the park like a home run... You can't win like that.
rows.display_text:
「That's why every shot went sailing out
of the park like a home run... You can't
win like that.」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: Too true. Though in my case, I'm downright envious of Hanae's power.
rows.display_text:
「Too true. Though in my case, I'm
downright envious of Hanae's power.」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Good work out there, Doctor. I... had a lot of fun being your teammate.
rows.display_text:
「Good work out there, Doctor. I... had a
lot of fun being your teammate.」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: My whole body's creaking like an old engine. I think I'll go soak in the hot spring once more.
rows.display_text:
「My whole body's creaking like an old
engine. I'll go soak in the hot spring
once more.」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Heh heh... I'll rub your shoulders for you afterward.
rows.display_text:
「Heh heh... I'll rub your shoulders for
you afterward.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Everyone...! I regret the interruption to your well-earned rest, but an emergency has arisen!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone...! Sorry to interrupt your
well-earned rest, but an emergency has
arisen!」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: What's wrong, Sandman!?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong, Sandman!?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Zeravire has appeared in this area. It seems it was likely hiding within the magma of a nearby volcano.
rows.display_text:
「Zeravire has appeared nearby. It was
likely hiding within a nearby volcano's
magma.」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: Understood. We'll move to intercept immediately.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. We'll move to intercept
immediately.」

rows.speaker: Arthur
rows.en: B-but, Captain! Since everyone was off resting, we haven't got a sortie roster put together!
rows.display_text:
「B-but, Captain! Everyone was resting,
so we haven't got a sortie roster
together!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: ...Tessera, what's the status of the Sandman Cup?
rows.display_text:
「...Tessera, what's the status of the
Sandman Cup?」

rows.speaker: Tessera
rows.en: Currently, the first round has ended and the eight teams advancing to the quarterfinals have been decided.
rows.display_text:
「The first round has ended, and the
eight teams advancing to the quarterfinals
are decided.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Then have those teams sortie.
rows.display_text: 「Then have those teams sortie.」

rows.speaker: Arthur
rows.en: Wh-what!?
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what!?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: They're teams that made it past the first round. Their teamwork shouldn't be an issue.
rows.display_text:
「They're teams that made it past the
first round. Their teamwork shouldn't be
an issue.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: All right...! Everyone who's already been eliminated will fall back and support them!
rows.display_text:
「All right...! Everyone who's already been
eliminated will fall back and support them!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Then, if I may be so bold, allow me to take command for today...!
rows.display_text:
「Then, if I may be so bold, allow me to
take command for today...!」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: All right!!
rows.display_text: 「All right!!」

rows.speaker: Toria
rows.en: Game, set! The final goes to the Eiji and Lunamaria pair!
rows.display_text:
「Game, set! The final goes to the Eiji
and Lunamaria pair!」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: We did it! A ZAFT Red never disappoints!
rows.display_text:
「We did it! A ZAFT Red never
disappoints!」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Sis... table tennis wasn't even part of the Academy's curriculum...
rows.display_text:
「Sis... table tennis wasn't even part of
the Academy's curriculum...」

rows.speaker: Tessera
rows.en: Congratulations, Lord Eiji, Lady Lunamaria.
rows.display_text:
「Congratulations, Lord Eiji, Lady
Lunamaria.」

rows.speaker: Marinia
rows.en: As the champions, the two of you are granted the right to challenge Lord Sandman's team.
rows.display_text:
「As the champions, the two of you are
granted the right to challenge Lord
Sandman's team.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Heh heh... the time's finally come to make Sandman eat his words!
rows.display_text:
「Heh heh... the time's finally come to
make Sandman eat his words!」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: But I wonder who Sandman's partner is...?
rows.display_text:
「But I wonder who Sandman's partner
is...?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Congratulations, Eiji, Lunamaria. First, allow me to salute your victory.
rows.display_text:
「Congratulations, Eiji, Lunamaria. First,
allow me to salute your victory.」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: There he is... the final boss...!
rows.display_text: （There he is... the final boss...!）

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Come on then, Sandman. I'll show you what I've got when I'm serious.
rows.display_text:
「Come on then, Sandman. I'll show you
what I've got when I'm serious.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Heh... Allow me to introduce my partner, then.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... Allow me to introduce my partner,
then.」

rows.speaker: Umee
rows.en: Go easy on us, would you, Eiji, Lunamaria dear?
rows.display_text:
「Go easy on us, would you, Eiji,
Lunamaria dear?」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: G-Granny!!
rows.display_text: 「G-Granny!!」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: What!? Sandman's partner is the old lady!?
rows.display_text:
「What!? Sandman's partner is the old
lady!?」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Ma'am... have you ever played table tennis before?
rows.display_text:
「Ma'am... have you ever played table
tennis before?」

rows.speaker: Umee
rows.en: I do like pickled scallions, but table tennis, I really couldn't tell you.
rows.display_text:
「I do like pickled scallions, but table
tennis, I really couldn't tell you.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Rest assured, Umee. Leave these two young ones to me.
rows.display_text:
「Rest assured, Umee. Leave these two
young ones to me.」

rows.speaker: Umee
rows.en: How reassuring. A handsome man really does talk different, don't he.
rows.display_text:
「How reassuring. A handsome man really
does talk different, don't he.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: You're kidding me...! You're gonna take on the two of us all by yourself!?
rows.display_text:
「You're kidding me...! You're gonna take
on the two of us all by yourself!?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Heh... Teaching arrogant young men who don't know their own limits about the towering wall called reality -- that, too, is an adult's duty...
rows.display_text:
「Heh... Teaching cocky young men the
towering wall of reality is an adult's
duty too...」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: I'll take you both on with this!
rows.display_text: 「I'll take you both on with this!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: A slipper!?
rows.display_text: 「A slipper!?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Wh-what...!? He's using that as a racket!?
rows.display_text:
「Wh-what...!? He's using that as a
racket!?」

rows.speaker: Tessera
rows.en: Amazing...
rows.display_text: 「Amazing...」

rows.speaker: Chuil
rows.en: Payo! Now that's Lord Sandman for you!
rows.display_text: 「Payo! Now that's Lord Sandman for you!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Is that really how it works!?
rows.display_text: 「Is that really how it works!?」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Don't underestimate us...! You'll be crying for mercy soon, Sandman! Let's go, Lunamaria!!
rows.display_text:
「Don't underestimate us...! You'll be
crying for mercy soon, Sandman! Let's go,
Lunamaria!!」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: R-right...!
rows.display_text: 「R-right...!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Fall beautifully, young ones.
rows.display_text: 「Fall beautifully, young ones.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: What happened after that was truly a nightmare.
rows.display_text:
（What happened after that was truly a
nightmare.）

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Everyone present that day must have felt real terror at Mr. Sandman's merciless play...
rows.display_text:
（Everyone present that day must have
felt real terror at Mr. Sandman's
merciless play...）

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: First, the vanishing serve!!
rows.display_text: 「First, the vanishing serve!!」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Waugh--!!
rows.display_text: 「Waugh--!!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Ha ha ha! Next, the vanishing smash!
rows.display_text: 「Ha ha ha! Next, the vanishing smash!」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Kyaah!
rows.display_text: 「Kyaah!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Ha ha ha ha ha, how about that! Next, a serve so sloooow a fly could land on it!
rows.display_text:
「Ha ha ha ha ha, how about that! Next,
a serve so sloooow a fly could land on
it!」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: D-daaaaaaaammit!!
rows.display_text: 「D-daaaaaaaammit!!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
rows.display_text:
「Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Ha
ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: Welcome back, Sandman.
rows.display_text: 「Welcome back, Sandman.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Thank you for holding down the fort, Raven. $c has headed off to Gibraltar Base.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you for holding down the fort,
Raven. $c has headed off to Gibraltar
Base.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: That look on your face... you seem refreshed.
rows.display_text:
「That look on your face... you seem
refreshed.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Thanks to that, I've made up my mind -- to confess my past sins to them...
rows.display_text:
「Thanks to that, I've made up my mind
-- to confess my past sins to them...」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: Sandman...
rows.display_text: 「Sandman...」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Here's a souvenir. Take it, Raven.
rows.display_text: 「Here's a souvenir. Take it, Raven.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: This is... a VIP free pass, good at hot springs all over the world!
rows.display_text:
「This is... a VIP free pass, good at hot
springs all over the world!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: It was originally meant to be the Sandman Cup's prize, but in the end, it stayed in my hands.
rows.display_text:
「This was meant to be the Sandman Cup's
prize, but in the end, it stayed with me.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Raven... someday, take off that mask and come to a hot spring with me.
rows.display_text:
「Raven... someday, take off that mask
and come to a hot spring with me.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: ...Yes.
